bead.title: Fix hybrid-async bounded-debt/apply-lag gate failure at 1M+ scale
bead.description:
After pqueue-864b1c74 fixed the recovery-replay pagination bug, the hybrid-async 1M-resident release evidence run (performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m) now completes recovery and disk-loss reconstruction correctly (exact resident counts, well within wall-time budgets) but still reports bars_met=false: bounded_debt_ok=false, bounded_debt_apply_lag_max=5999 exceeding bounded_debt_apply_lag_ceiling=2000. Every other gate (attribution, segment density, hot-path-within-20pct, recovery, disk-loss) passes. This gate was never previously exercised end-to-end at 1M scale — the run always panicked mid-recovery before reaching it — so this is a newly-surfaced, previously-masked defect, not a regression from pqueue-864b1c74's fix.

Root-cause lead (not proven): pqueue-8e5e7846 (commit 9d15873) raised the test harness's background deferred-projection-flush tick interval from a hardcoded 250ms to env_u64("PQUEUE_HYBRID_DEFERRED_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS", 60_000) (crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:142) specifically to stop it from perturbing the 100k ack-p99 latency measurement. At 100k resident the whole hot-path measurement finishes well inside 60s so this is harmless; at 1M the hot path plausibly runs long enough for the tick to fire, but spawn_composed_flusher's deferred-tick branch calls try_flush_deferred_projection() for a single bounded chunk (DEFAULT_DEFERRED_FLUSH_CHUNK=250) per tick rather than draining to caught-up, so one catch-up cannot meaningfully reduce a backlog that grows with resident volume. The apply_lag_ceiling (4x batch size) assumes the deferred SQLite checkpoint stays structurally near-caught-up; at 1M+ with this cadence/chunk it does not.

In scope: root-cause (confirm or refute the above lead) and fix the bounded-debt/apply-lag gate failure at 1M+ scale for the hybrid-async backend, without reintroducing the 100k ack-p99 flakiness that pqueue-8e5e7846 fixed (re-verify performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m at PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=100000 still passes after any change). Out of scope: any other correctness or performance gate.

Full evidence: .ddx/executions/20260701T230418-239aab3e/hybrid-1m-recovery-gap-fix-and-new-bounded-debt-gap.md (bead pqueue-864b1c74).
bead.acceptance:
1. PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=1000000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture passes with bars_met=true.
2. PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=100000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture still passes with bars_met=true (no ack-p99 regression reintroduced).
3. cargo fmt --check passes.
